about:
Country Hillside Designs operates from Ryder, North Dakota. The business traces its roots to 2010 when owner Patti Shelkey began creating custom embroidery designs from a home-based workshop. In 2021 the company adopted its current name, reflecting Shelkey's vision of a cottage-style shop where customers could explore personalized apparel.

The shop provides custom decoration services including embroidery, digital print-and-cut, screen printing, heat-transfer application, and vinyl cutting. Equipment includes two commercial embroidery machines, a digital print-and-cut printer, two heat presses, and a vinyl cutter. A small team of designers and technicians works with clients to produce corporate jackets, spirit wear, event merchandise, and personalized gifts.

Customers range from local businesses and schools to rodeo associations and nonprofit fundraisers. Examples include 4-H club towels, graduation blankets, family reunion shirts, sports team apparel, western wear for the Badlands Circuit Finals Rodeo, and breast-cancer-awareness campaign items.

Shelkey emphasizes personalized service and storytelling through stitching, drawing on her rural background. The company highlights quality-first production, expert care from an experienced team, and proven results that help clients represent their brand or commemorate milestones.
